minecraft:written_book_content.title: Found in the Dark
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Unknown Miner
pages: {"text": "Day 9. Broke through into a hidden chamber while mining near camp. A stone altar in the middle. On it, a melon."}
{"text": "The melon had gone bad. Green, wrinkly, smelled like death.\nI leaned in for a better look.\nThat's the last thing I remember."}
{"text": "Woke up on the floor, head pounding. Next to me, a book stuck in some kind of hard black web. Took ages to pry loose.\nCopying it here:"}
{"text": "\"They walk at night now. Villagers in black robes. They slip out of the village after dark, one by one, and don't come back till dawn.\""}
{"text": "\"They bring things back with them. Large oval things, leathery. They leave them inside people's houses. Under beds. In corners.\""}
{"text": "\"Tonight I followed them. Into the caves, down and down.\nThen something hit me from behind.\""}
{"text": "\"I woke up stuck to the wall. Black gunk, hard as resin, holding my arms. There are others on the walls. Some are still moving.\""}
{"text": "\"Tell my wife she needs to get off this planet. These things are all teeth and armor, and they are waking up...\""}
{"text": "That's it. I'm getting out of here. Corporate can bill me. I don't care. I'm leaving now.\n\nI just wish my chest would stop hurting."}
